entries.english: Civil disputes involving residents of Aub and its surroundings, and Jewish affairs. Includes disputes between Ottilia Meder zu Adelhofen and Michael Nickel zu Holzhausen over a farm exchange; the von Rosenberg lords' complaint before the Imperial Chamber Court against Bishop Julius of Würzburg over his prohibition on trade with Jews; debt statements, insults, misconduct, injuries, marital disputes, Jewish disputes and investigations, miscellaneous affairs, and a citation by the Mergentheim court. Dates range from 1570 to 1629. Extent: 1 volume.
